title: IDOR: any user can read others' invoices by id
description: GET /api/invoices/{id} returns the invoice without checking that it belongs to the authenticated user. Incrementing the id enumerates and discloses every customer's invoice (names, addresses, amounts). get_invoice in api/invoices.py looks the record up by primary key only, with no ownership check.
poc_text: Authenticate as user A, request /api/invoices/1001 through /api/invoices/1100, observe other users' invoices.
